text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the people of Israel and say to them: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民说：我，上主是你们的天主。

text_en: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived, and you shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, to which I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.
text_cn: 你们不要仿效你们住过的埃及地的习惯，也不要仿效我正要领你们去的客纳罕地的习惯，不要随从他们的风俗；

text_en: My ordinances you shall observe and my statutes you shall keep, following them: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 应执行我的规定，遵守我的法令，依照遵行：我，上主是你们的天主。

text_en: You shall keep my statutes and my ordinances; by doing so one shall live: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 你们应遵守我的法令和规定；遵守的人必因此获得生命：我是上主。

text_en: None of you shall approach anyone near of kin to uncover nakedness: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 你们中任何人不可亲近任何血亲，去揭露她的下体：我是上主。

text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, which is the nakedness of your mother; she is your mother, you shall not uncover her nakedness.
text_cn: 你不可揭露你父亲的下体和你母亲的下体：她是你的母亲，不可揭露她的下体。

text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife; it is the nakedness of your father.
text_cn: 你父亲妻子的下体，你不可揭露，那是你父亲的下体。

text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether born at home or born abroad.
text_cn: 你姊妹的下体，不论她是你父亲的女儿，或你母亲的女儿，或在家生的，或在外生的，你不可揭露她们的下体。

text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter or of your daughter’s daughter, for their nakedness is your own nakedness.
text_cn: 你儿子的女儿，或你女儿的女儿的下体，你不可揭露，因为她们的下体是你的下体。

text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, begotten by your father, since she is your sister.
text_cn: 你不可揭露你父亲妻子的女儿的下体，因为她是你父亲所生的，是你的姊妹，你不可揭露她的下体。

text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister; she is your father’s flesh.
text_cn: 你父亲姊妹的下体，你不可揭露，因为她是你父亲的骨肉。

text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s flesh.
text_cn: 你母亲姊妹的下体，你不可揭露，因为她是你母亲的骨肉。

text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother, that is, you shall not approach his wife; she is your aunt.
text_cn: 你父亲兄弟的下体，你不可揭露，也不可亲近他的妻子；她是你的叔伯母。

text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law: she is your son’s wife; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
text_cn: 你儿媳的下体，你不可揭露。她是你儿子的妻子，你不可揭露她的下体。

text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife; it is your brother’s nakedness.
text_cn: 你兄弟妻子的下体，你不可揭露；那是你兄弟的下体。

text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, and you shall not take her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter to uncover her nakedness; they are your flesh; it is depravity.
text_cn: 你不可揭露了一女人的下体又揭露她女儿的；不可娶她儿子的女儿，或她女儿的女儿，揭露她的下体，她们都是她的血亲：这是丑行。

text_en: And you shall not take a woman as a rival to her sister, uncovering her nakedness while her sister is still alive.
text_cn: 你不可娶一女人又娶她的姊妹，做她的情敌，在她活着的时候，揭露她姊妹的下体。

text_en: You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness while she is in her menstrual uncleanness.
text_cn: 女人在月经不洁期中，你不可接近，揭露她的下体。

text_en: You shall not have sexual relations with your kinsman’s wife, and defile yourself with her.
text_cn: 你近人的妻子你不可与她同寝，为她所玷污。

text_en: You shall not give any of your offspring to sacrifice them to Molech, and so profane the name of your God: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 你不可使你任何一个子女经火祭献给摩肋客，亦不可亵渎你天主的名：我是上主。

text_en: You shall not lie with a male as with a woman; it is an abomination.
text_cn: 你不可与男人同寝，如同与女人同寝一样：这是丑恶行为。

text_en: You shall not have sexual relations with any animal and defile yourself with it, nor shall any woman give herself to an animal to have sexual relations with it: it is perversion.
text_cn: 你不可与任何兽类同寝，为它所淫污；女人亦不可委身与走兽，同它交合：这是逆性邪恶。

text_en: Do not defile yourselves in any of these ways, for by all these practices the nations I am casting out before you have defiled themselves.
text_cn: 你们不可以任何这样的事玷污自己，因为这些民族以这一切事玷污了自己，我正要由你们面前将他们驱逐；

text_en: Thus the land became defiled; and I punished it for its iniquity, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.
text_cn: 甚至连这地也玷污了，所以我必追究这地上的罪恶，使这地唾弃地上的居民。

text_en: But you shall keep my statutes and my ordinances and commit none of these abominations, either the citizen or the alien who resides among you
text_cn: 至于你们，应遵守我的法令和规定；不论是本地人，或是寄居在你们中间的外方人，这样丑恶的事，一件也不许做，

text_en: (for the inhabitants of the land, who were before you, committed all of these abominations, and the land became defiled);
text_cn: 因为在你们以前住在这地上的人，做过这一切丑恶的事，玷污了这地方。

text_en: otherwise the land will vomit you out for defiling it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
text_cn: 希望这地不因你们而再受到玷污，将你们唾弃，如同唾弃了你们以前的民族。

text_en: For whoever commits any of these abominations shall be cut off from their people.
text_cn: 因为，凡做任何一件这样丑恶的事的，这样的人，都应由民间铲除。

text_en: So keep my charge not to commit any of these abominations that were done before you, and not to defile yourselves by them: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 所以你们应遵守我的禁令，不可仿效你们以前的人所有的丑恶风俗，免得因此受到玷污：我，上主是你们的天主。”
